Friday at 10 works, I'll move the invite.
Thanks. Also, our CTO will be on that call too, she wants to hear about the integrations.
Great. Can I ask what you pay today?
We pay our current vendor about thirty a year. Budget for a replacement hasn't been discussed yet.
